question: For each IPL season, identify the top three batsmen with the highest total runs scored and the top three bowlers with the most wickets taken, excluding ‘run out’, ‘hit wicket’, and ‘retired hurt’ dismissals. In the event of ties in runs or wickets, break the tie using the smaller player ID. Then output these six players in matched positions—batsman 1 with bowler 1, batsman 2 with bowler 2, and batsman 3 with bowler 3—in ascending order of the season ID, along with each player’s total runs or wickets.
sql:
WITH batsmen_ranked AS (
    SELECT m.season_id, bb.striker as player_id, CAST(SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS INTEGER) as total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY SUM(bs.runs_scored) DESC, bb.striker ASC) as pos
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON bs.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY m.season_id, bb.striker
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY SUM(bs.runs_scored) DESC, bb.striker ASC) <= 3
),
bowlers_ranked AS (
    SELECT m.season_id, wt.player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_wickets,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, wt.player_out ASC) as pos
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN match m ON wt.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE wt.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt')
    GROUP BY m.season_id, wt.player_out
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, wt.player_out ASC) <= 3
)
SELECT br.season_id, 
       br.player_id as batsman_id,
       br.total_runs,
       wr.player_id as bowler_id,
       wr.total_wickets
FROM batsmen_ranked br
JOIN bowlers_ranked wr ON br.season_id = wr.season_id AND br.pos = wr.pos
ORDER BY br.season_id, br.pos
